name: findParcelHelpHtmlPo
description: Configuration currently not in use and/or visible.
value:
The most reliable way to search is by using the parcel number. If you do not know the parcel number here are some resources that may help:
  • You can find it on your property tax statement
  • The Assessor Treasurer's website has some search tools
  • You can also use Public GIS to search for a parcel
When searching by an address try using just the building number and street name without any types or directions. For example instead of entering '123 Main Street South' enter just '123 Main'. You will get a list of potential matches and you can select the correct parcel from there.

name: termsOfUseHtmlPo
description: Text for Online Permits Terms of Use modal
value:
Online Submittal Instructions

The information in this system is intended for use by Planning and Public Works staff in conjunction with permit processing. Individual projects may require multiple applications that are reviewed separately and the review may be abbreviated, condensed, or be specific to the application and not the project as a whole. Information obtained from this system should only be used in conjunction with the official County file or after confirmation by County staff.

RCW 42.56.070(8) prohibits the release of lists of individuals requested for commercial purposes, and requestor expressly represents that no such use of any such list will be made by user or its transferee(s) or vendee(s). "Commercial purposes" means contacting or in some way personally affecting the individuals identified on the list with the purpose of facilitating commercial activities.

Do you agree with these terms of use?
